ai.title: Move handler-function-type into agent-runtime
ai.summary: Refactored `CodebuffToolHandlerFunction` type definition. Moved from `backend/src/tools/handlers/handler-function-type` to `@codebuff/agent-runtime/tools/handlers/handler-function-type`. Updated imports across multiple tool handler files in `backend/src/tools/handlers/tool/`.

eli5.text: The developers moved a piece of shared instruction code from one part of their system into a common tool library that multiple parts of the software already use. Every tool file that relied on that instruction now pulls it from the new location instead of the old one. You, as someone using the software, would not notice any difference in how it behaves today, since this is purely internal housekeeping that keeps the behind-the-scenes setup cleaner and easier to maintain.

ai.title: Inject databaseAgentCache into AgentRuntimeDeps
ai.summary: Refactored `AgentRuntimeDeps` to include `databaseAgentCache` as a required dependency, replacing the global `databaseAgentCache` variable in `agent-registry.ts`. This change updates `getAgentTemplate` and `clearDatabaseCache` to accept the cache map via parameters, ensuring consistent state management across backend, testing, and evals implementations. Files modified include `backend/src/impl/agent-runtime.ts`, `backend/src/templates/agent-registry.ts`, `common/src/testing/impl/agent-runtime.ts`, `common/src/types/contracts/agent-runtime.ts`, and `evals/impl/agent-runtime.ts`.

eli5.text: When the system looks up an agent from the database, it now reads from a per-backend cache that each backend server manages itself, rather than a single shared cache that all servers used to pull from. The backend, test, and evaluation versions all set up their own fresh cache when they start, and you can still clear each one out for testing. This means each running backend keeps its own isolated lookup table, so stale entries in one won't leak into another. The change is live today and takes effect the moment the servers pick up the new code.

ai.title: Terminal command output truncated past 50k chars
ai.summary: run-terminal-command.ts now truncates stdout to 50,000 characters using truncateStringWithMessage with remove: 'MIDDLE'. This prevents excessive output from overwhelming the context window. stderr remains untruncated and is combined with stdout as before.

eli5.text: When you run a command in the terminal, if the output was extremely long (longer than 50,000 characters), it could overwhelm or freeze the assistant's view. Now, any terminal output that gets pasted back to the assistant gets shortened to the first few thousand characters plus the last few thousand, with the middle cut out, so very long outputs no longer break things. You won't notice this unless a command normally produces massive output; in that case, you'll just see that the middle of the result is missing instead of everything freezing up.

ai.title: Agent runner debug flag and judge timeout extension
ai.summary: Added `DEBUG_ERROR` flag to `evals/buffbench/agent-runner.ts` for dumping error traces to JSON files. Increased judge and trace analyzer timeouts from 10 to 20 minutes in `judge.ts` and `trace-analyzer.ts`. Scope limited to internal evals infrastructure.

eli5.text: When the internal evaluation system runs its agent judges and trace analyzers, they will now wait up to 20 minutes before giving up, instead of stopping after 10. A debugging switch was also added to the agent runner so that, if turned on, it will save detailed error traces as JSON files. These adjustments only affect the internal evals infrastructure used to test agent performance.

ai.title: SDK build emits sourcemaps and declaration maps
ai.summary: SDK build scripts now generate linked sourcemaps for ESM and CJS bundles via `sourcemap: 'linked'` in `sdk/scripts/build.ts`. `tsconfig.build.json` enables `declarationMap: true` to support source navigation for type definitions. This improves debuggability and IDE navigation for SDK consumers without altering runtime behavior.

eli5.text: If you use this software toolkit inside a code editor, you can now jump straight to the lines that built the tools you're using instead of landing in a bundled, unreadable file. The toolkit now ships extra map files alongside its published code that point back to the original source, so clicking an error or type takes you to where it was actually written. These map files are generated automatically during the toolkit's build, and they only affect how your editor shows the toolkit's internals, not how the toolkit behaves when you run it.

ai.title: Move agent-registry to @codebuff/agent-runtime
ai.summary: Refactors agent registry imports to use @codebuff/agent-runtime package instead of local backend templates. Extracts fetchAgentFromDatabase into new backend/src/templates/agent-db.ts. Updates imports across backend API, websockets, tools, and evals scaffolding. Resolves circular dependency in spawn-agent-utils by replacing dynamic import with static loopAgentSteps import.

eli5.text: The agent registry has been reorganized so it lives in one shared location that the backend now reads from, which lets the backend, real-time connections, helper tools, and eval scripts all tap the same source instead of each keeping their own copy. You won't see a new button or different output yet, but this kind of cleanup is what makes it safer to add new capabilities later without breaking the things that already work. It also fixes a long-standing tangle in how new agents get started, which in practice means the system is slightly more reliable when spinning up fresh agent runs. This is in place today as part of the normal build.

ai.title: Remove redundant agent registry mock in loop-agent-steps.test.ts
ai.summary: Deleted unused `getAgentTemplate` mock and type import from `backend/src/__tests__/loop-agent-steps.test.ts`. The mock module definition was unnecessary for the current test setup, causing lint or TS errors. Change is internal to the backend test suite. No user-facing behavior affected.

eli5.text: The team deleted a leftover test fixture from the internal test suite that wasn't being used anymore. This affects only the backend developers running tests locally; end users and customers see zero difference. If you open the project, the test file is shorter by 11 lines and no longer imports an unused mock helper.

ai.title: initialSessionState adds legacy cwd string overload
ai.summary: Overloaded initialSessionState in sdk/src/run-state.ts to accept legacy (cwd, options) signature alongside options object. Added InitialSessionStateOptions type and dynamic fs import fallback when options.fs missing. Maintains backward compatibility for SDK consumers while normalizing internal destructuring.

eli5.text: If you call the session-starting function with just a folder path, it now works again; you no longer have to pass a big settings object as the only argument, so existing integrations that supply the old-style folder-path-plus-options will keep running without edits. The code lets the function accept either a folder path string alone or the full settings object, and when no file system is supplied it quietly loads a default one, so nothing that used the previous calling style will suddenly break.
